text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and subtle joy. The first image, with its quiet, glass-walled room, hints at collaboration and growth—perhaps a reminder of the importance of motivation in collective endeavors. The second scene, vibrant and alive with color and information, radiates the electric energy of inquiry and experimentation. I sense inspiration all around, inviting me to explore the links between motivation, research, and the love of one's pursuits. It feels right to be guided and supported by others, as I feed my passion for learning and creation.
